decision_rule: No proposed core is promoted to repository creation until ownership, contract, code overlap, security and maintenance costs are reviewed.

assessments.decision: Reuse existing reliability gates and experiments; consolidate contracts/tests, do not create another core yet.
Hierarchical memory already owns durable memory, git intelligence and evidence; do not create duplicate.
Existing Playwright browser project already has runtime, policy and tests; harden subresource egress before reuse.
Reuse typed event envelope and transactional idempotency research; a transport-level delivery protocol is still not established.
Reuse statistical and ML validation labs; define shared evidence schema before extracting a core.
Current calculator/compute research is incomplete; do not create until actual hardware measurements and workload contracts exist.
QuantLab is existing trading validation owner; OOS lab is a narrow leakage demo.
META API provides local tool discovery/execution gateway prototype; orchestration and provider routing need a versioned contract.
Existing graph is conversion/trading-focused and economy is simulation; general offer/supply-demand graph remains a distinct unresolved domain.
Tool catalog and governance registries exist, but external provider capability registry is not yet verified.
Existing graph and quant components already cover much of path/cycle and relative-value logic.
Governance, deny-by-default tool policy and capability ceilings already exist; unify policy contracts rather than create a separate authority.
Simulation includes reputation model; real-world verified reputation and dispute evidence remain distinct.
Need a focused order/catalog/settlement ownership audit before deciding whether a core is missing.
Existing finance and payment layers provide accounting/settlement rails and simulation credit; lender discovery and jurisdiction-specific credit offers remain unverified.
Pay System supports payment routing and provider capabilities, not a verified bank-card product comparison marketplace.
No source-reviewed licensed microloan offer aggregation was found; audit credit/lending domain before creation.
Multi-provider and cross-border payment routing overlap strongly; remittance-specific corridor discovery and compliance comparison need scope definition.
Payment rails do not establish cashback provider aggregation; inspect existing app/merchant projects before creation.
Trading risk and market analytics exist; broker discovery, account opening and broker-product comparison remain distinct.
Bank/provider integration and financial accounting are present as boundaries; a bank-product comparison router is not established.
Existing offline lead candidate store and geographic viewer cover parts of discovery and location; property listings, valuation, availability and transaction workflow remain distinct.
Lead OS provides a narrow offline lead workflow; AI Company is a stub. General enterprise supplier discovery remains unimplemented.
Market Graph is a conversion graph and search_engline is a HardNAV simulation; neither proves a general classifieds graph.
Some discovery, route and payment primitives exist; a cross-domain demand/supply marketplace router is not established.
Local tool gateway and provider API boundaries exist; global API provider discovery, metering and failover remain unverified.
